intro: Finland gave the world the Moomins, the music of Sibelius, bold Marimekko prints and a love of heavy metal.

chapters.title: Moomins and music
text: Tove Jansson created the Moomins in 1945. Jean Sibelius's Finlandia became a symbol of the nation, and architect Alvar Aalto shaped modern design. Finland has more heavy metal bands per person than almost anywhere, and the monster-costumed band Lordi won Eurovision in 2006.

chapters.title: Food and odd contests
text: Rye bread, Karelian pasties and salty liquorice are favourites. Finland hosts quirky world championships in wife-carrying, air guitar and mobile phone throwing.
